title: WPMS/2316/2019 of GARHWAL SABHA LIBRARY MUSSOORIE Vs ADDITIONAL CHIEF ADMINISTRATVIE

paras.text:
WPMS No.2316 of 2019
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.

Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate, for the respondents.
 The petitioner had made a construction without
any authority of law and without sanction of plan from
the Development Authority, which is Mussoorie
Dehradun Development Authority. Consequently sealing
order dated 04.05.2019 was passed by the Development
Authority which was challenged by the petitioner in an
appeal, which was dismissed by the appellate authority
vide order dated 27.06.2019. Against which the petitioner
has filed a revision which has also been dismissed vide
order dated 31.07.2019 by the Revisional Authority.
Aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present writ
petition.
 Learned counsel for the MDDA submits that the
sealing order has already been passed and this
construction is liable to be demolished.
 Learned counsel for the MDDA also submits that
the map submitted by the petitioner himself shows
certain areas which have been constructed by him are
liable to be demolished and in case the petitioner
demolishes the said construction then the MDDA may
consider for the remaining area for compounding in case
the bye laws permit, but the petitioner must show his
bona fide and demolish the said construction on his own
and thereafter move an application for compounding
which will be considered in accordance with law.
 In view thereof, nothing further needs to be done
by this Court.
 The writ petition stands disposed.
